question: The lockfile cannot be refreshed because `npm install` is denied by the task allowlist. How should #175 proceed?
context: Bumping typescript to 7.x and vitest to 5.x requires regenerating package-lock.json with npm install, which the allowlist denies (npm-subcommand-denied). Hand-editing the lockfile is unsafe. Without it, outcome o1 cannot be met.

options.title: Allow npm install for this task
options.description: Permit `npm install -D typescript@^7.0.2 vitest@^5.0.5` so the worker can finish the upgrade end to end.

options.title: Maintainer refreshes the lockfile
options.description: A maintainer runs the npm install on the branch and the worker continues with adaptations.

options.title: Ship Vitest 5 only
options.description: Hold TypeScript at 5.x; still requires npm install to refresh the lock.
